item.command:
/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
import json,re
p='/mnt/data/LSF/data/financebench/processing/AMD_2021_10K_reconstructed.json'
with open(p) as f:
    data=json.load(f)
texts=data['texts']
for i,t in enumerate(texts):
    txt=t.get('text','')
    if re.search(r'outstanding.*common stock|common stock.*outstanding|shares of common stock', txt, re.I):
        print('IDX',i,'PAGE',t.get('page_no'))
        print(txt)
        print('---')
PY"
